name: the-most-useful-site-in-the-world
displayName: The Most Useful Site in the World — 1276 Browser Tools
description: Catalogue of 1276 free, client-side tools (calculators, converters, generators, simulators) across 29 categories. Every tool is a visual, privacy-preserving browser tool; the machine specs under api/tools/<slug>.json describe inputs, outputs, formula and sources so agents can link to or reimplement a tool without scraping HTML.

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List all 1276 tools with category, slug, and description. Filter by category or free-text query.

tools.name: describe_tool
tools.description: Full machine spec for one tool (inputs, outputs, formula, sources, embed URL).

slug.description: Tool slug, e.g. bmi, mortgage, compoundinterest

tools.name: open_tool
tools.description: Open the interactive tool in the user's browser.

notes: All outputs are static JSON/HTML. No auth, no POST, no server-side computation. YMYL tools (Health & Fitness, Finance & Money) include disclaimers in their deep pages under /tools/<slug>.html. Instrumentation is privacy-preserving and capped; see docs/INSTRUMENTATION.md.
